cards.t: Binance Suffers Record $6.3B Hack and Massive Post-Withdrawal Outflows
cards.b: Binance experienced a record $6.3 billion hack attributed by the FBI to North Korea, leading to billions in net outflows after withdrawals reopened.

per.BNB: BNB faced severe volatility and massive exchange withdrawals following the security breach.
per.BTC: Bitcoin spot ETFs saw record outflows of $643 million on Friday following the hack announcement.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Full recovery timeline for the SAFU fund and complete recovery status of the stolen funds.

cards.t: BTCPay Server Urges Users to Shut Down Servers Amid Hot Wallet Thefts
cards.b: BTCPay Server advised operators to switch off servers running outdated software versions after reports of unauthorized attackers draining hot wallets.

per.BTC: Security concerns impact self-hosted merchant payment nodes on older versions.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact total financial losses incurred across affected merchants.

cards.t: Strategy Spends $65.5M on Bitcoin and $208.2M on STRC Buybacks
cards.b: Strategy purchased an additional 811 bitcoin for $65.5 million and spent $208.2 million buying back its STRC preferred shares.

per.BTC: Continued institutional treasury accumulation by Strategy provides buying support.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
cards.missing: Total updated treasury holdings after the latest purchase.

cards.t: XRP Ledger Prepares Fix to Resolve Stablecoin Token Minting Flaw
cards.b: The XRP Ledger is on track to implement a network fix addressing a flaw that could have allowed stablecoin partners to inappropriately print new tokens.

per.XRP: XRP itself remains unaffected while validators activate the network patch.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST

cards.b: Strive acquired another 124 BTC for $10 million, inching closer to becoming the second-largest public company holder of bitcoin.

per.BTC: Treasury accumulation adds consistent corporate buying pressure.

cards.t: Bitmine Adds 8,573 ETH to Holdings Amid Market Resilience
cards.b: Bitmine added 8,573 ETH last week, lifting its total holdings to 6.06 million ETH as leadership downplayed the market impact of the Binance hack.

per.ETH: Substantial institutional accumulation supports Ethereum's supply dynamics.
